resharper_wrap_enumeration_style #

The enumeration's wrap style, in the language-generic spelling the export writes. ⚠ Probed rather than reasoned about: eleven fixtures under this repository's own .editorconfig, one cleanupcode invocation per configuration, each fixture first shown to move under the key that really governs its construct. Inert at all three values on a seven-member enum, at 120 and at 60 columns, and with csharp_max_enum_members_on_line = 10 and csharp_wrap_enum_declaration = wrap_if_long in the same run — that pair moves the file on its own and adding this key to it changes nothing. csharp_wrap_enum_declaration governs an enum's layout.
